description: This file defines the TableProvider interface for Spark SQL connector catalog, including methods for schema inference, partitioning, table retrieval, and external metadata support.

classes.name: TableProvider
classes.description: Interface for v2 data sources without a real catalog, responsible for schema inference, table retrieval, and metadata support.

methods.name: inferSchema
methods.description: Infers the schema of a table based on provided options.

methods.name: inferPartitioning
methods.description: Infers the partitioning of a table; defaults to no partitioning.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Returns a Table instance with specified schema, partitioning, and properties for read/write operations.

methods.name: supportsExternalMetadata
methods.description: Indicates if the source supports external table metadata; defaults to false.
